summary.headline: Miraculous Eclipse and Astronomical Signs
summary.text: Manuel’s discussion of the miraculous solar eclipse at Christ’s Passion, arguing that scientific knowledge of eclipses and stars reveals divine intervention; it also recounts a Thessalonian high priest ending a famine through astronomical observation and begins a tale about a buried chest.
